title: Milestone validator feature templates
description: Reusable feature templates for scrutiny-validator and user-testing-validator features. Add these to features.json after all implementation features for a milestone are complete. Aligned with Factory Droid milestone validation cadence.

scrutiny-validator.description: Scrutiny code review and test validation for milestone {{milestone}}. Reviews all completed features, checks code quality, verifies test coverage, and produces a synthesis report.
preconditions: All implementation features for milestone {{milestone}} are complete
expectedBehavior: All feature handoffs for {{milestone}} reviewed for code quality
Test coverage verified for all features
No blocking issues found or documented for resolution
Synthesis report produced with shared observations

user-testing-validator.description: End-to-end user testing validation for milestone {{milestone}}. Verifies functional behavior from a user perspective, running acceptance tests against validation contract assertions.
expectedBehavior: All VAL-* assertions for {{milestone}} features verified
Validation-state.json updated with pass/fail for each assertion

usage: Replace {{milestone}} with the actual milestone name (e.g., 'memory-enhancements'). Copy the expanded template objects into the features[] array in features.json.
